summary: Examples of setup: saving facts to a tree, filtering memory or interface facts, collecting only facter or network/virtual subsets, minimal or no facts, Windows custom fact paths, and delegating fact gathering to db servers.
questions: How do I show only memory facts for all hosts?
How do I gather facts for db servers while running on app servers?
How do I collect only the minimum facts ad hoc?
How do I use custom facts from C:\custom_facts on Windows?
How do I skip facter and ohai even if installed?

answer_card.title: setup examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```
ansible all -m ansible.builtin.setup --tree /tmp/facts
ansible all -m ansible.builtin.setup -a 'filter=ansible_*_mb'
ansible all -m ansible.builtin.setup -a 'gather_subset=!all,network,virtual'
ansible all -m ansible.builtin.setup -a 'gather_subset=!facter,!ohai'
ansible all -m ansible.builtin.setup -a 'gather_subset=!all,!min'
ansible windows -m ansible.builtin.setup -a "fact_path='c:\custom_facts'"
```
Delegated facts:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.setup:
  delegate_to: "{{ item }}"
  delegate_facts: true
  loop: "{{ groups['dbservers'] }}"
```
